title: Seasonal-naive CPI print-deviation late-window drift (vintaged first prints, PIT-gated entry, daily 16:00-NY grid)

blindness_declaration.statement: Written with ZERO outcome exposure: no scored/PnL/smoke/novelty numbers for this cycle were read; no backtest executed. Only timing, availability, coverage and count evidence from the pinned P0 census/gate was consumed.

mechanism.story: A CPI first print that deviates from the publicly computable seasonal-naive continuation of the vintaged index carries fresh inflation news. Policy-path repricing for small-open-economy CPI (GB/CA/AU/NZ) and for US CPI is not completed instantly by the marginal dealer; it diffuses through real-money accounts, benchmark rebalancers and corporate hedgers whose dealing windows are periodic, and through market-maker inventory absorption that unwinds over days to weeks.
mechanism.forced_or_late_participant: Forced/late participants: (i) benchmark- and index-tracking FX books that must rebalance after the rate-path repricing only at their scheduled dealing windows; (ii) corporate hedgers with standing calendar-based fixings; (iii) THIS LANE ITSELF is a declared late participant: the vintaged channel only proves the print value a median of 26 days (GB), 26 (CA), 16 (AU), 25 (NZ), 1 (US) AFTER publication, so every non-US entry is necessarily weeks late. The hypothesis is specifically that a measurable fraction of the deviation-conditioned repricing SURVIVES the PIT-provable availability lag plus the holding horizon, after costs.
mechanism.why_it_might_exist: Seasonal-shape deviations are the least-salient form of inflation news: the public's free continuation (apply last year's same-month seasonal ratio to the latest index) is computed by almost nobody in real time, and the vintaged archive itself ingests non-US CPI weeks late. Slow diffusion of low-salience, magnitude-bearing information is the claimed edge source; it is NOT the sign of the release (that class is closed, see ancestry_defense).
mechanism.when_it_must_fail: It must fail (expectancy <= 0 after costs) if the late window is efficient, i.e. if deviation repricing completes within days of publication. It must die by falsification if the identical book is reproduced by a nominal-yield-level exposure (V8 law), by a clock-only (calendar drift) shadow, or by a non-print-day placebo. It dies at D2 if pooled ancestry |rho| > 0.20 vs the full failure inventory (accepted in advance).

information_source_and_surprise_construc.information_source: realized vintaged CPI first-print index levels vs a frozen seasonal-naive predictor computed from the same vintaged archive; NO consensus/forecast data anywhere (plan §9).
information_source_and_surprise_construc.predictor: I_hat_sn(m) = I(m-1) * ( I(m-12) / I(m-13) ), where I(k) is the vintaged index level for month k in the vintage in force at the decision instant (point-in-time read of the vintaged series, never a later revision).
information_source_and_surprise_construc.predictor_name: seasonal-naive one-step (last-year same-month seasonal ratio applied to the latest vintaged level)
information_source_and_surprise_construc.surprise: s1 = 100 * ( I_print(m) / I_hat_sn(m) - 1 ), in percentage points of index deviation.
information_source_and_surprise_construc.i_print_source: vintaged_first_value of the pinned census first-release instant (the value as first carried by the evidenced vintaged channel).
information_source_and_surprise_construc.pit_rule: All predictor inputs I(m-1), I(m-12), I(m-13) are read as-of the decision instant (the vintage in force then). I_print is the first-release vintaged value. No value that entered its vintage after the decision instant may be read (P-1..P-6 chain; ONE_EVENT_LAG impossible by construction).

frozen_parameters.neighbour_parameterization: rolling-MAD normalized: z1 = s1 / MAD24, MAD24 = 1.4826 * median(|s1,k - median(s1)|) over the economy's previous first-release surprises, expanding window, minimum 8 prior surprises required to fire; fire iff |z1| >= 1.0; holding 5 grid days
frozen_parameters.threshold_selection_basis: blind frozen priors chosen before any outcome; no tuning permitted after any number is seen (P-15)

GB.quoting: CCY/USD, long = long GBP vs USD

CA.quoting: USD/CAD, long = long USD vs CAD, therefore long CAD = short USDCAD

AU.quoting: CCY/USD, long = long AUD vs USD

NZ.quoting: CCY/USD, long = long NZD vs USD

US.quoting: US print conditions the USD leg of all four pairs; 4 pair-decisions per US event, 1 unit each

universe.direction_law: s1 >= +threshold => long the funded-economy currency vs USD (GB: long GBPUSD; CA: short USDCAD; AU: long AUDUSD; NZ: long NZDUSD; US: long USD => short GBPUSD/AUDUSD/NZDUSD and long USDCAD). s1 <= -threshold => the mirror. |s1| < threshold => no position. Two-sided by construction: no static currency or dollar bias in the anchor.

clock.decision_grid: daily 16:00 America/New_York (zoneinfo, DST-correct; 16:00-NY = 20:00Z EDT / 21:00Z EST) on FX trading days; frozen V9 representation
clock.event_set: census instants with is_first_release_of_period == true (307 rows), pinned census sha256 e8a35d23ce64ce71a8d30792750b877c387de3692af1e4d17391ea4cc35b4abe; the 16 CA WDS correction instants (ordinals 2-4) are NOT conditioning events
clock.pit_anomaly_policy: EXCLUDE first-release instants carrying pit_notes (fail-closed): 1 event, NZ ref 2019-04 pub 2019-07-16 'archive_led_bulletin'. Event set after exclusion: 306.
clock.availability_bound: A(e) = 23:59:59Z on operative_vintaged_available_from. Rationale: the print value's evidenced availability is date-granular (FRED/ALFRED realtime_start is a date) even where the publication timestamp is exact (CA 12:30Z evidenced, NZ 10:45 Auckland evidenced), so the conservative end-of-day rule binds on the VALUE leg for every economy.
clock.entry_rule: decision day D(e) = first 16:00-NY grid instant strictly AFTER A(e). CONSEQUENCE DECLARED: a same-day 16:00-NY decision NEVER sees a print whose availability bound is that same date (16:00-NY = 20:00/21:00Z < 23:59:59Z) - in particular the same-day 16:00-NY decision does NOT see a US print published that day.

GB.publication_evidence: date-only ONS bulletin calendar -> conservative end-of-day UTC

CA.publication_evidence: WDS calendar v3 true-UTC per row (08:30 America/Toronto -> 12:30Z typical)
CA.note: exact publication time is recorded but the date-granular value availability binds the entry clock

AU.publication_evidence: date-only ABS release calendar -> conservative end-of-day UTC

NZ.publication_evidence: Stats NZ calendar 10:45 Pacific/Auckland -> DST-corrected exact UTC

US.publication_evidence: FRED realtime archive first-appearance, date-only -> conservative end-of-day UTC
US.note: US legs are the freshest entries (next FX grid day); the same-day 16:00-NY decision never conditions on a same-day US print

clock.dst_rule: zoneinfo America/New_York local->UTC conversion with DST fixtures; NZ/AU publication instants converted with zoneinfo Pacific/Auckland; date-only evidence gets 23:59:59Z

window.basis: census s0_window (V9 start inherited; end = last calendar-evidenced non-US print publication with a vintaged realized value); tail-trim law respected, no current-vintage backfill

warmup.requirement: vintaged index history of at least 13 months before each reference month (I(m-1), I(m-12), I(m-13) must exist in the vintage in force at the decision instant)
warmup.neighbour_extra: MAD24 normalization requires >= 8 prior first-release surprises of the same economy (expanding); earlier events of an economy do not fire the neighbour arm (declared coverage note)
warmup.structural_status: satisfied: vintaged feeds start 1948-1955, far before the 2018-04 S0 start; warmup is a per-event data-window rule, not a burn-in period

features: s1 (or z1 for the neighbour) is the ONLY signal feature; no yield, momentum, or price feature enters the signal
features_and_lags.lags: vintaged index months m-1, m-12, m-13 relative to reference month m (m-2, m-14 NOT used in P1)
features_and_lags.explicit_non_features: no consensus/forecast data (no authority exists); no nominal yield level in the signal (yield level appears ONLY inside the mandatory control arm)

entry_exit_fills.entry: at the D(e) 16:00-NY grid price of the staged spot series (declared dependency), iff |s1| >= threshold at that instant; 1 unit notional per fired pair-decision (US events: 4 pair-decisions x 1 unit)
entry_exit_fills.exit: at the grid instant H = 5 grid days after entry (next grid day if that instant is not a trading day); forced exit at the 2025-04-30 grid instant for positions whose horizon extends past window end (declared tail convention)
entry_exit_fills.fills: entry fill and exit fill each executed once at grid prices; positions in the same pair from different events are held independently (no netting), each exiting at its own horizon
entry_exit_fills.no_lookback_guards: signals computed only from information PIT-available at D(e); the frozen validator refuses any fill whose conditioning value postdates the decision instant (V3 lesson encoded)

costs.model: measured FX spread per pair at stress tier, charged once per fill (entry and exit are separate fills); never vendor-stated
costs.authority: Q-8 re-measured constants to be published by the P1 lane in this cycle; at proposal time NOT_YET_MEASURED => declared dependency; if P1 constants are absent at D2/implementation, cost verdict is NOT_RUN (fail-closed), never an assumed spread
costs.reference: plans/PLAN_forex_ng1.md §5 (Q-8: FX spread measured); V8/V9 dual-book kernel inherited at P1

arm_battery.name: FXNG1-A4-P1-ANCHOR
arm_battery.config: s1 seasonal-naive deviation, |s1| >= 0.10 pp, direction per direction_law, H = 5 grid days

arm_battery.name: FXNG1-A4-P1-NEIGH-MAD24
arm_battery.config: z1 = s1 / MAD24 (expanding, min 8 prior surprises, 1.4826-consistent MAD), |z1| >= 1.0, same direction law, H = 5 grid days
arm_battery.role: different parameterization of the surprise (scale-free thresholding vs raw pp); if the neighbour out-earns the anchor the frozen parameterization is not mechanism-bearing (V8 R2 standard)

arm_battery.name: FXNG1-A4-P1-CTL-DGS10LEVEL
arm_battery.config: identical event days, pairs, horizons and 1-unit magnitudes as the fired anchor book, but direction carries ONLY a nominal-yield-level exposure with print conditioning removed: sign = +1 (long funded currency vs USD; for US events long USD in all four pairs) iff the DGS10 level as-of D(e) (vintaged S2) is below its trailing 252-grid-day median, else -1
arm_battery.role: V8 LAW MANDATE: if this control reproduces the anchor (same-sign expectancy >= 0.5x anchor), the CPI-deviation book is a nominal-yield-level exposure in new words => family dead (falsification-by-control cluster #14 law)

arm_battery.name: FXNG1-A4-P1-SHADOW-CLOCK
arm_battery.config: identical event days, pairs, horizons, magnitudes as the fired anchor book, but direction = constant +1 (always long the funded currency vs USD; for US events always long USD in all four pairs); zero information content
arm_battery.role: Q-7 clock-only shadow: isolates pure calendar-clock + static-drift exposure; reproduces the anchor (same-sign >= 0.5x) => the clock explains it => dead

arm_battery.name: FXNG1-A4-P1-PLACEBO-SHAM7D
arm_battery.config: sham calendar = every fired anchor event day shifted +7 calendar days; if the shifted day collides with a real fired event day of the same pair, shift again +7 (max 4 attempts, else drop); direction = the SAME surprise sign as the source event (stale information, no new print occurs); same horizon, magnitude, fills and costs
arm_battery.role: V5/V6 house-standard sham-calendar placebo on non-print days; reproduces the anchor (same-sign >= 0.5x) => entry timing carries no print information => dead

ancestry_defense.v7_reaction_direction_closed: V7 closed the reaction-direction class (sign-of-release continuation, entry at publication horizon, both sides of the economy boundary). This lane differs structurally: (i) conditioning is a magnitude-bearing deviation vs a frozen naive predictor, NOT the sign of the release; (ii) entry is strictly after PIT-provable vintaged availability (median 26/26/16/25/1 days after publication for GB/CA/AU/NZ/US), a horizon V6/V7 never represented; (iii) two-sided thresholded, no static direction. The distinction is ALSO measured: D2 pooled |rho| <= 0.20 vs the full inventory including the V6 anchor book and V7 books; over the bar => lane dies at D2 (accepted in advance).
ancestry_defense.v8_nominal_level_law: V8 falsification-by-control #14 made a nominal-exposure control MANDATORY on every yield/inflation lane. Carried as CTL-DGS10LEVEL on the identical clock; no nominal yield level enters the signal. If the control reproduces the anchor, the family is dead by law.
ancestry_defense.v9_ppp_vetoes: V9 A5-P1/P2 died as PPP/real-rate LEVEL-misalignment books (rho 0.3034/0.3119 vs the V8 anchor). This proposal carries no PPP, real-rate, or level-misalignment state anywhere; conditioning is event-time, two-sided, deviation-based. D2 rho gate vs the V9 veto books applies.
ancestry_defense.v5_sham_calendar_standard: sham-calendar placebo mandatory for calendar mechanisms; carried as PLACEBO-SHAM7D.
ancestry_defense.v3_pit_chain: P-1..P-6 incident chain honored: conservative end-of-day availability bounds, as-of vintage reads, fill validator refuses any conditioning value that postdates the decision instant.
ancestry_defense.v9_high_finding_binding: non-US legs come ONLY from the vintaged channel (pinned sha256s above); current-vintage revised-in-place tables are FORBIDDEN for GB/CA legs (and all non-US legs).

frozen_rule_order: R1 MECHANICAL: anchor after-cost expectancy at stress tier <= 0 => family dead (plain negative); remaining rules moot
R2 NOMINAL_EXPOSURE (V8 law): CTL-DGS10LEVEL same-sign expectancy >= 0.5x anchor => dead (nominal-yield-level exposure in new words)
R3 CLOCK_ONLY (Q-7): SHADOW-CLOCK same-sign expectancy >= 0.5x anchor => dead (calendar drift explains it)
R4 PLACEBO: PLACEBO-SHAM7D same-sign expectancy >= 0.5x anchor => dead (timing-inspecific stale-sign exposure)
R5 NEIGHBOUR_PARAMETERIZATION: NEIGH-MAD24 expectancy > anchor expectancy => frozen parameterization not mechanism-bearing => dead (V8 z504 standard)
falsification_rule.external_gate: D2 ancestry pooled |rho| <= 0.20 vs full inventory (incl. V8 nominal-level shadow and V9 vetoes), margin recorded (P-2); over the bar => D2 VETO
falsification_rule.no_threshold_moves: no rule, threshold, or horizon changes after any scored number is seen (P-15); smoke numbers kill + disclose, never select

expected_failure_interpretation.R1_with_clean_controls: the PIT-late window carries no net deviation drift after costs: the late-participant repricing is complete by the time the print is provably observable. CONSISTENT WITH (not contradicting) the V7 closure - V7 closed entry-at-publication reaction-direction, and this lane could not observe that horizon; a null here licenses NO claim about the publication-instant reaction.
expected_failure_interpretation.R2_fires: the CPI-deviation book is a nominal-yield-level exposure in new words; the V8 law re-fires on the inflation lane exactly as designed.
expected_failure_interpretation.R4_fires: stale-sign exposure on wrong days; entry timing carries nothing (V5/V6 standard).
expected_failure_interpretation.R5_fires: the raw-pp thresholding is not mechanism-bearing; scale-free normalization is, and the family still dies (no rescue by re-ranking arms).
